issue.title: Typecheck fails: UButton `onClick` rejects an inline assignment handler
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13
- vue-tsc: 2.2.0

### Description

`<UButton @click="open = true" />` fails `vue-tsc` with TS2322. The handler type only accepts a function that returns void, so an inline assignment is rejected. It worked in 1.3.

```
error TS2322: Type 'boolean' is not assignable to type 'void'.
```

### Reproduction

https://github.com/johndoe/acme-select-repro

Run `pnpm install && pnpm typecheck`.

### Expected

Inline assignment handlers should typecheck, like on native elements.
